title: cassia fasciculata var. brachiata
intro: Cassia fasciculata var. brachiata, commonly known as Senna brachiata, is a plant species belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae) and is native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna brachiata include its ability to act as an anthelmintic, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Senna brachiata include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
